name: Akurateco
description: Akurateco is a PCI DSS-compliant white‑label payment gateway and payment orchestration platform that lets PSPs, acquirers, banks, marketplaces, and online merchants launch and scale branded payment services without building their own infrastructure. It provides 700+ ready payment connectors, intelligent routing and cascading, advanced risk and fraud management, recurring payments and tokenization, comprehensive analytics and billing, and flexible deployment (SaaS or on‑prem) backed by 99.99% uptime and a dedicated payments team.

events.n: Check Transaction Status by Payment ID
events.d: Look up a transaction's current status using its payment ID.
Finalize a previously authorized transaction to collect the specified amount.
Initiate a full or partial refund for a settled payment. Verifies the payment is settled, ensures the refund amount does not exceed the original, and submits the refund request.
Cancel an authorized or pending payment before it settles. Sends a void request and returns the gateway's response.
Create a checkout session and return a payment URL customers can use to complete the order.
